You really have two main choices:

• 20ML trial size: a smaller bottle that lasts about 14 days with twice-daily use. Good if you want to try it first or need something very travel-friendly.
• 100ML full size: the larger bottle that lasts about 70 days with twice-daily use. Better if you want your regular daily routine.

You can also choose between two blends:
• Neutral Blend: a simple option if you want to keep it straightforward.
• Kyoto Blend: the same 3-in-1 moisturizer in the Kyoto Blend version.

All of them are the same type of product: a 3-in-1 formula with toner, serum, and cream in one, made for all skin types and used morning and night after cleansing.
